Record Class ScoreRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
database.ScoreRecord
Record Components:
nickname - the unique username of the player
score - the final score achieved by the player in the match
playerCount - the total number of players who participated in the match
date - the timestamp when the match concluded, used for sorting and historical records
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record ScoreRecord(String nickname, int score, int playerCount, LocalDateTime date) extends Record implements Serializable
Represents an immutable data transfer object (DTO) containing a player's match result. This Java record safely transports player performance data from the game logic to the persistence layer. It is immutable and implements Serializable for potential network transmission.
